reasoning: The icon is just the two letters 'RT' inside a half-rounded button frame representing a gamepad's Right Trigger prompt. Because it consists primarily of a two-letter abbreviation, it fails the glanceability test for general to-do lists and is easily confused with Retweet, Real-Time, or Ray Tracing; tasks about gaming hardware are much better served by a full controller icon.
